beats.text: The yen is nearly 160 to the dollar. So, is Japan worried? Hard to say, really.
Hot US inflation keeps pulling money into the dollar, and the rate gap keeps widening.

beats.speaker: hiroshi
beats.text: Import prices jumped 24.8%. Energy, food, raw materials all hit harder.
beats.name: Monetary policy economist

beats.text: Tokyo has spent a record twenty seven trillion yen defending it this year. Worried? Maybe they just really like yen.

beats.speaker: david
beats.text: Fed meets December 9. BOJ follows on the 17th.
beats.name: David Chen

beats.text: Record spending, daily warnings, two crunch meetings in December. Yeah... we still can't rule out that they're fine.

plan.hook: Is Japan Worried? Hard to Say
